items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Well, I bought the album, and then Harvey made me return it. Harvey moved to me and said, get the other one.

ctx.x: I just assumed I'd talk about that album. All right. Okay. That's the thing that will haunt me to my grave. It'll follow me to my grave.
Well, I bought the album, and then Harvey made me return it. Harvey moved to me and said, get the other one. So I'll get the other one if you return that.

It's funny. It's the same band. We did two albums within three weeks with the same band. And really, the Yellow Dog Blues album had some, a couple of good, some of my best arrangements were on the Yellow Dog Blues album. And they got thrown into the trash can. The tapes got sidetracked. So they would have enough time to put Miss New Orleans on it because of the, the guy says, oh, it'll sell more records with that song on it.
